notes.title: What’s Coming in the Next Major Update?
notes.notes:
Hello, dear players,

We have many plans for the next big update, but for now, our top priority is to enable more interaction with women. Therefore, we will focus on this topic in the upcoming update.

Here are some details: 


 After having a good conversation with a woman, you will be able to get her phone number.



 Once you have her phone number, you can arrange a date and go pick her up in your car.



 You can take the woman you pick up in your car on a drive and visit various places.



 Locations you can visit will include restaurants, clothing stores, burger joints, parks, etc.



 When you arrive at a restaurant, you can sit at a table with the woman and place an order.



 While waiting for your order and having your meal, you can engage in a pleasant conversation with her.



 If your date goes well, you can invite her to your home for a coffee.



 If you have a good relationship with her, you may get closer and possibly share a romantic moment.


This is the general idea of the features we plan to implement, and we will start working on them immediately. After the update, there may be some additions or changes. Additionally, to avoid making you wait longer, we might release an early update.

The update process will depend on the feedback we receive from you. However, I must say that negative reviews and refunds have affected us both financially and morally. Still, we will continue to develop the game, and we would like to thank everyone who has purchased the game, supported us, and left positive reviews. We appreciate you!

See you in the next updates! Don't forget to share your thoughts and suggestions; they will help shape the updates.

notes.title: HOTFIX
notes.notes: Based on your feedback, we've made numerous bug fixes and improvements. Also, a huge thank you to everyone who has supported us so far – we're grateful to have you!
